name: Huelva (Spain)
description: White field with a light blue square at the centre charged with the crowned arms of the city of Huelva (a castle above an anchor on blue, inscribed).
history: The flag of Huelva is rectangular, white with a blue die or square at the centre, charged with the arms of the city.

features.role: Huelva arms — castle above an anchor on blue, inscribed
